description: Cryptographic agility to rapidly change algorithms in response to vulnerabilities is not implemented. This signal indicates that transitioning to new cryptographic standards may be difficult.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring crypto flexibility. Includes algorithm-agnostic designs, crypto library abstraction, and post-quantum readiness.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through cryptographic architecture review, algorithm agility assessment, and crypto transition readiness testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
